transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well... my wife told me I had to come. She says it's just regular talk, but... I know what I'm hearing. 

Down at the domino table, the men... they slip in these little messages. Just for me. Sometimes the fella on the radio does it, too. Warning me to be careful. She don't believe me, but... I guess that's why I'm sitting here.
How long have you been noticing these messages?
Well... it's been a while now. I suppose... maybe nine months or so. They come and go, you know. But yeah... about that long.
Do you ever hear voices speaking to you when there is no one around or when the room is completely quiet?

Well... sometimes. 

Just... some afternoons, when the house is real quiet. I might hear... my old friend. He'll call my name from out on the porch. Or maybe I'll hear him humming an old choir song. Sounds real clear... like he's just standing right there. But... that's all.
Over these past nine months, have you had times where you felt unusually down, depressed, or hopeless for weeks at a time?
No... can't say that I have. I just... I feel alright most days. Nothing like that.
Have you had any serious medical problems, head injuries, or new physical health issues around the time these experiences started?
No... nothing like that. My health's been fine. Haven't hit my head or... had any big problems. Just the same as always.
Have you ever felt like an outside force or someone else was controlling your thoughts, body, or actions against your will?
No... no, I wouldn't say that. It's just me in here. Nobody's... making me do things.
Do you ever feel like your private thoughts are being broadcast or transmitted out loud, so that other people can hear them?
No... I don't think so. They just... they stay in my head. Nobody's hearing 'em but me.
